recognize_zh: 周邊血與骨髓中有大量中型細胞，核呈雙葉或雙核、染色質粗而呈車輪狀，細胞質中等量、偏藍且無顆粒，外觀像單核球或低顆粒前骨髓球；流式顯示 CD45 陰性、CD38 與 CD138 強陽性的異常漿細胞群，免疫固定電泳見 IgG kappa 帶，符合原發性漿細胞白血病。
features: Medium-sized cells with bilobed, cleft or binucleate nuclei mimicking monocytoid or hypogranular promyelocytic cells
Coarse, clock-face-like clumped chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm, some with a paler perinuclear zone
Panel C: CD45-negative/dim cells with bright CD38 and CD138 co-expression (26% abnormal plasma cells)
Panel D: immunofixation shows monoclonal bands in the IgG and kappa lanes
describe_en: Composite figure. Peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate smears show numerous medium-sized atypical cells with bilobed, cleft or binucleate nuclei, coarse chromatin, and moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm, closely mimicking monocytoid cells or hypogranular promyelocytes. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD45-negative population with bright CD38 and CD138 expression, and immunofixation electrophoresis shows monoclonal IgG kappa bands. Findings are consistent with primary plasma cell leukemia with atypical bilobed plasma cell morphology.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL cells have bilobed nuclei but are CD45+, CD33+, CD13+, MPO-positive and CD138-negative with PML::RARA.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have fine chromatin, folded nuclei, nonspecific esterase positivity and CD45+CD14/CD64+, lacking bright CD38/CD138.
Plasmablasts are larger with open chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are often EBER-positive, rather than coarse-chromatin plasma cells with a serum paraprotein.
